messages.高い体力・防御レベルと強力な守備「回避」で敵の攻撃を透かす回避タンク。マッチはS: An evade tank with high HP, high Defense Level, and a strong Evade. Take clashes with S3 Pañata Party, while landing S1 and S2 unopposed to apply Sinking.
messages.守備「回避」: マッチ威力5〜15、スキルレベル人格Lv+5。回避成功時に呼吸回: **Defense skill — Evade**: Clash Power 5–15, Skill Level Identity Lv +5. Poise Count increases by 1 on a successful Evade. His HP is 98–307, and his Defense Level is Identity Lv +3.
messages.S3「パニャータパーティー」: 1コイン、マッチ威力8〜19。この人格で唯一まと: **S3 — Pañata Party**: 1 Coin with Clash Power 8–19. His only skill that can Clash properly. On hit, pushes his own Stagger Threshold back by 50% of the damage dealt. If the target's SP is below 0, Critical chance increases in proportion to it, and with 5 or more Poise Count he gains +30% Critical damage.
messages.S1・S2は一方攻撃用: マッチ威力はS1「舞い」が3〜7/4〜8、S2「激情の: **S1 and S2 are for one-sided attacks**: Their Clash Power is low: S1 Baile y Rola at 3–7/4–8 and S2 Danza de Pasión at 4–7/5–8. S1 inflicts 2/4 Sinking and gains +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 4 Sinking. S2 inflicts Sinking with Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ (Coin Ⅱ also Sinking Count) and gains +2 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Sinking.
messages.バトルパッシブ「遊興」(憂鬱×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 回避成功時、(憂鬱共: **Combat passive — Júbilo Hedonista (3 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On a successful Evade, there is a (Gloom Resonance×5)% chance to push the Stagger Threshold back by the Evade skill's power. S3 and his Defense skill (the Defense skill at Uptie Ⅳ) are Gloom, making it easy to aim for.
messages.敵の攻撃は基本的に「回避」で処理する。S3が手元にあれば、勝てそうな敵スキルとの: Handle enemy attacks with Evade as a rule. If S3 is in hand, use it to Clash enemy skills it can likely beat. Land S1 and S2 as one-sided attacks to stack Sinking and drain enemy SP. His low Speed and lack of Aggro make covering allies difficult, so his role is to hold out without falling himself. In Sinking teams, the Coin Power conditions on S1 and S2 are also easy to meet.
